item.harddayz.grad_launcher.desc: Right-click the ground to deploy. 20 tubes, salvo up to ~400 blocks.
item.harddayz.iskander_launcher.desc: Right-click the ground to deploy. Ballistic missile, 60-2000 blocks.
item.harddayz.sam_launcher.desc: Right-click the ground to deploy. Shoots down hostile missiles within 250 blocks.
item.harddayz.ballistic_missile.desc: Right-click an Iskander to load. Huge blast.
item.harddayz.sam_missile.desc: Right-click a SAM system to load.
item.harddayz.designator.desc: RMB to mark a target (up to 1000 blocks). RMB a launcher to load coordinates; fire with the button.
screen.harddayz.sam_info: Automatic mode: engages hostile missiles within 250 blocks.
message.harddayz.no_target: No target found (too far or sky).
message.harddayz.no_designation: Mark a target with the designator first.
message.harddayz.sam_auto: The SAM works on its own - just load it.
item.harddayz.shahed_launcher.desc: Right-click the ground to deploy. Rack for 5 strike drones, up to 3000 blocks.
item.harddayz.shahed_drone.desc: Right-click a Shahed launcher to load.
item.harddayz.fpv_drone.desc: Right-click to launch and fly from its camera. LMB or a fast crash detonates. V to exit.
item.harddayz.recon_drone.desc: Right-click to launch. Zoom camera (wheel), LMB drops a grenade (3). V to exit.
message.harddayz.pilot_start: Drone: B - start/stop engine, WASD, Space/Shift - altitude, LMB - fire, V - exit.
hud.harddayz.help_recon: RMB mark point   LMB drop   wheel zoom   V exit
screen.harddayz.drive_hint: RMB to drive, Shift+RMB panel, V panel from the cab
item.harddayz.shahed_238.desc: Twice as fast and higher; harder for air defense.
item.harddayz.shahed_131.desc: Small strike drone with a weaker warhead.
item.harddayz.gerbera.desc: Almost no warhead. Draws air-defense missiles.
item.harddayz.ramp_launcher.desc: Single launcher for any Shahed. RMB for the panel.
item.harddayz.grad_p_launcher.desc: Portable tripod for one Grad rocket.
item.harddayz.ew_station.desc: Jams hostile drones within 128 blocks: FPV and recon fall, Shaheds lose their course.
message.harddayz.ew_auto: EW works on its own: jams hostile drones within 128 blocks.
item.harddayz.target_log.desc: The recon drone writes points here (RMB from its camera). RMB list, Shift+RMB clear, RMB a launcher for its panel.
item.harddayz.mine_ap.desc: RMB a block to place. Arms in 3 s, allies are safe. Shift+hit to remove.
item.harddayz.mine_at.desc: Triggers on vehicles only. Allies are safe. Shift+hit to remove.
item.harddayz.operator_terminal.desc: RMB to take control of your nearest flying Shahed (up to 420 blocks). Mouse steers, W/S speed, LMB detonate, V release.
hud.harddayz.help_shahed: Mouse course   W/S speed   LMB detonate   V release
message.harddayz.hq_no_faction: You are not in a faction - HQ not registered. /war join
message.harddayz.faction_defeated: Faction %s lost all HQs and is defeated!
message.harddayz.war_no_rights: Only the war creator or an admin can end it.
item.harddayz.mg_nest.desc: Place on the ground, RMB to man it. LMB fires. Load with belts.
item.harddayz.sam_manual.desc: Cheaper than automatic. Man it, keep the target in the sight until lock, LMB to launch.
item.harddayz.mg_belt.desc: 50 rounds. RMB a machine-gun nest to load.
item.harddayz.supply_tablet.desc: RMB: faction shop - budget, purchases, delivery to the warehouse.
screen.harddayz.shop_not_commander: Heavy equipment (★) is ordered by the commander
screen.harddayz.shop_hint: Delivered to the faction warehouse, otherwise to the HQ
message.harddayz.shop_no_faction: You are not in a faction. /war join
message.harddayz.shop_commander_only: Only the commander can order heavy equipment.
message.harddayz.shop_heavy_limit: Too many heavy deliveries (max %s at once).
message.harddayz.shop_ordered: %s ordered %s x%s for %s - arrives in %s s.
message.harddayz.warehouse_set: Warehouse registered: %s %s %s. Deliveries will arrive here.
item.harddayz.radar_truck.desc: Place on the ground. Sees hostile missiles and drones within 600 blocks and feeds your SAMs and displays.
item.harddayz.radar_display.desc: RMB: air picture from your faction radars.
screen.harddayz.radar_info: The radar works on its own: feeds SAMs and radar displays.
message.harddayz.siren_set: Siren linked to your radar network.
message.harddayz.war_kit: Commander starter kit: 3 HQs, warehouse, supply tablet, radar display, siren.
screen.harddayz.copied: Copied - press Paste in the launcher panel.
message.harddayz.drone_dead: Drone battery is dead. Pick it up (Shift+hit) and place it again.
item.harddayz.interceptor_drone.desc: RMB - launch. Hunts the nearest enemy drone (~65% kill).
item.harddayz.lancet.desc: RMB - launch to the designator point (or where you look). Near the target you take control.
item.harddayz.wing_recon.desc: RMB - launch. Circles over the point for 6 minutes, reporting enemies to the radar net.
message.harddayz.lancet_control: Lancet on target - pick the target and dive! LMB - detonate.
item.harddayz.javelin.desc: RMB - sight, keep a vehicle in the box for 2 s to lock, then LMB - fire. Needs Javelin missiles.
message.harddayz.javelin_no_lock: No lock: aim at a vehicle.
message.harddayz.lives_mode: Lives mode: each team has %s lives. Out of lives - team loses.
item.harddayz.gun.desc: LMB - fire, RMB - aim. Reloads automatically when empty.
message.harddayz.parked: Drone parked. RMB - start engine, RMB again - launch. Shift+hit - pick up.
item.harddayz.attachment.desc: Hold the gun in the other hand and RMB to mount.
message.harddayz.attach_hint: Hold a gun in the other hand.
message.harddayz.parked_engine: Engine started. RMB again to launch.
item.harddayz.rangefinder.desc: RMB - look (range and coordinates), LMB - save the point to the target log.
message.harddayz.drone_placed: Drone placed. Connect: RMB on it or the operator terminal (up to 320 blocks).
item.harddayz.ka52.desc: W/S - forward/back, A/D - turn, Space - up, Ctrl - down. LMB - cannon, RMB - rockets.
item.harddayz.mi8.desc: Pilot + 3 troops. Space - up, Ctrl - down. RMB - rockets.
item.harddayz.field_shovel.desc: RMB on ground - dig a trench: 3 blocks forward, 2 deep.
item.harddayz.bandage.desc: Hold RMB: stops light bleeding, +3 HP. RMB on a downed ally - revive faster.
item.harddayz.tourniquet.desc: Stops any bleeding at once, 30 s slowness.
item.harddayz.medkit.desc: Hold RMB: +12 HP, stops bleeding. RMB on a downed ally - revive (twice faster).
item.harddayz.painkiller.desc: Regeneration and damage resistance for a while.
message.harddayz.downed: You are badly wounded! Wait for a teammate to revive you (RMB on you). Hold Shift 3 s to give up.
message.harddayz.no_fuel: Out of fuel! Use a jerrycan on the vehicle (RMB).
message.harddayz.lancet_manual: Lancet climbed - you have control. LMB - detonate.
message.harddayz.drone_busy: Someone is already piloting this drone.
message.harddayz.drone_foreign: This drone belongs to someone else.
message.harddayz.out_of_range_h: Out of reach: %s blocks, height difference %s (max %s on flat ground).
item.harddayz.kub_drone.desc: RMB: hand launch towards the designator point or where you look.
item.harddayz.molniya.desc: Placed on the ground. RMB: engine, RMB again: take off, then you fly it.
item.harddayz.baba_yaga.desc: Hexacopter with two heavy bombs. RMB on it: connect.
